body.says: A list of places, holons or the collections a way of looking groups into, each item a slot offered a face, seen at a glance, numbered where the whole numbers its parts.

cards.says: Whether its items stand as cards side by side, where there is room, rather than one under another.

number.says: The number of the whole whose items these are, which each item's number runs on from.

numbered.says: Whether each item is numbered by its place.

body.title: List
